claims: Claude Design is 'the most underrated thing Anthropic has ever made'
Grab free templates from React Video Editor and have Claude customize them to your brand
Drop a brand design system (Apple/Stripe/Spotify) from the Awesome Claude Design collection and Claude builds in that style 'in two minutes'
Paste any website URL and Claude rebuilds it; connect Higgsfield for images/video
how_to_steps: Motion graphics: download a free template from React Video Editor, give it to Claude Design, ask it to restyle to your brand (example shown: animated 'MARIAH' lettering)

Brand style: pull a design-system file from the 'Awesome Claude Design' GitHub collection (e.g. Spotify), drop it into Claude Design, ask for a component/page (example: Spotify-style 'ATX Austin, Texas' card and 'The food actually slaps' card)

Website clone: paste the URL of a site you like into Claude Design and ask it to rebuild it (example: a soda brand landing page 'Find your flavor' with Strawberry Lemon / Cherry Limeade / Watermelon cans); connect Higgsfield for generated imagery

relevance.why: Design systems as context for Claude is directly useful for a founder shipping app UIs; the 'clone any website' and motion-graphics angles are nice-to-have for marketing.

implement_score.why: Low effort: find the Awesome Claude Design collection, keep a chosen design-system markdown in the repo for Claude Code to reference. Claude Design itself needs checking for availability on the founder's plan.
